correctness.rationale: Two omitted original vertices force an isolated selected subdivision vertex, so at least n-1 selected originals and equally many subdivision vertices are necessary. At equality, incidence matching requires component edges equal nonroot vertices: a nontrivial root tree and only other unicyclic components. Each root tree has one orientation, each unicyclic component two, producing 2^c; labelled Cayley/tree-cycle exponential formula yields A_n(y). Independent direct matching enumeration for n=2..6 reproduced totals 2,9,64,645,8406, with n=5 distribution 625+20y.
residual_risks: Independent enumeration checked n<=6 only; unrestricted proof relies on component classification and species EGF.
